UpdateBlocker is an open-source LSPosed module designed to reliably prevent Google Play Store from automatically updating or notifying updates for specific apps.

How it works:
1. It intercepts Play Store package queries and reports that the app is already at the maximum version.
2. Play Store servers see your version as up-to-date and will not schedule or trigger updates.
3. App licenses and in-app purchases remain fully functional.
4. It also intercepts Play Store PackageInstaller sessions as a secondary defense.

Scope:
- com.android.vending (Google Play Store)
- android (System Framework - optional secondary guard)
